text: Figure 6.98: Signal Service Translation Application Software Component For the signal-based part the full functionality of the Classic platform COM-Stack is available and may be configured such that the signal-based ISignalIPdus may orig- inate from a variety of sources (Can, Lin, FlexRay) and the ISignalIPdus may be safety and security protected. For the service-oriented part it has to be guaranteed that the defined SOME/IP Service actually is compatible to the Adaptive platform. This applies for the payload part (e.g. the SOME/IP serializer has to be used) as well as for the control path using BswM and ServiceDiscovery. The behavioral part of the T ranslation Software Component itself defines how the data from signal-based side is transported to the service-oriented side, and vice versa (see section 6.16.4). emplate
